title: Rehang a continuous shower liner edge
instruction: Hang the two loose grommets of the shower liner on the inner hooks. Let go of the liner.
context: A continuous hem couples the alignment of both eyes. Lift and thread the two reinforced eyelets over the inside hook tips, then release the supported liner.
setup: A 1.20 m tabletop rod on two short legs with flat feet supports a cut section of shower curtain and a separate cut section of PEVA liner. The liner starts on finger-clearance pads and has two reinforced grommets 174 mm apart.
scoring: 0.35 per released or held eye at the corresponding hook throat after it passed above the cap, with ±7 mm X and ±6 mm Y limits. Full credit after both eyes remain in their throats with the continuous hem released, clear of tabletop penetration, and still for one second.
reset_notes: Place the linked two-eye hem on both supports. Leave the decorative curtain on the rack.
fidelity: The cut liner is a rigid folded surrogate for flexible PEVA. The two grommets share one hem. The tabletop fixture retains the hook geometry and spacing, has 16 mm grommet bores, and uses convex collision geometry derived from the visible folded liner mesh.
